text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happen to pass by the arcade one day,
when...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot someone I don't expect absorbed
in a
dancing game. Her expression is one
of total
focus as she moves... but her
rhythm is abysmal.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Huff... I can't do it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm so taken aback that I fail to look
away in time.
We make eye contact...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Before you say anything, let me speak.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I pride myself on being able to do most
tasks
better than the average person.
However...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
There's one thing I find myself inept
at—physical
activity.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I finish last in marathons, I've never
caught a ball
in my life, and I even had
to take the vaulting box
test multiple
times in gym class.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Straight As in every other subject, but
my PE
grades were dismal... Even now, I
become
exhausted after a day out.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As a trainer though, it's vital that my
physical
health be at a respectable level.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I was asked to do some
dance
coaching.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
But I can't dance, and my schedule
makes it
impossible for me to take any
classes to prepare...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a dignified poise, she gestures to
the screen
currently displaying a grand
combo score of zero.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
So I've been using this machine in my
spare time
to practice.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, it's much more difficult than I expected. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should buy some more
reference books.
Oh, but my
bookshelves are already
overflowing...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I'm just not built for dancing.
There must
be another way to get
better...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a real shock to see someone as
capable as her
struggling this much.
There must be some advice I
can give to
help...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Stamina is essential in
performing for
long periods of time. I
overlooked that.
choice_data_list: まずは体力をつけてみては？
何度でも挑戦してみましょう！
ちょっと今日は急いでいるので……

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Time to relocate to a more appropriate
space to
train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious about what she plans on doing, I
tag
along to her next destination.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'll start with ten laps—no, better to
begin with
five!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She continues jogging at a snail's pace
until night
falls.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Wheeze... I-I can't...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
choice_data_list: もう少しでゴールです！

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for the encouragement. It
helped me
push myself further.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I know it's not a grand gesture by any
means, but
please let me treat you to
some ramen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head over to a ramen restaurant and
take a
seat.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I hadn't run in years. It felt quite nice.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I think I have a slightly better
understanding of
what our racers see
every day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We end up talking about all sorts of
things over
dinner.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of training here, but the
weather
looks like it may take a turn for
the worse.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It won't do us any good to catch a cold...
Let's
call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I can't hope to gain
anything
without investing the effort.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
This is no time for self-pity! I need to
focus on
improving and nothing else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cha-cha-cha, cha, cha! ♪

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Interesting... If I lift my right foot when I jump, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cha-cha-cha, cha, cha! ♪

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
So that's what I need to do. Right, right,
left,
spin... Okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her hard work pays off, and she appears
to slowly
get the hang of it. A few hours
later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cha-cha-cha, cha, chaaa! ♪

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you... And, er, sorry for
making a
scene... Ahem!
choice_data_list: おめでとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I made quite a lot of progress, if I say so
myself.
I'm glad I kept at it.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate all your encouraging words.
Allow me
to buy you a drink as thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We go to a local bar where she treats me
to a
drink. Then, on our way out...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
While we may be trainers, I'm of the
belief that
we should be able to dance
to our racers' debut
songs at the very
least.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we could incorporate dance
lessons into
the trainer workshops.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize—apologies for
interrupting you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I'll see you at the academy, then.
